newsitem.title: ITALY: Stet chief welcomes shift to Treasury.
newsitem.headline: Stet chief welcomes shift to Treasury.

text.p: The head of Italian telecoms holding Stet said on Thursday that he welcomed the transfer of its shares from state industrial conglomerate IRI to the Treasury to prepare for privatisation next year.

"It suits us fine," managing director Ernesto Pascale told Italian news agency ANSA by telephone from Brazil, where he is preparing a bid for the auction of the Brazilian telephone company. "It is a measure which speeds up the privatisation process."
Stet was due to have been privatised by the end of March next year, but the government admitted earlier this month that such a timetable was now unfeasible.
The government also said then that it would merge Stet with its operating arm Telecom Italia.
The transfer of shares to the Treasury was conducted at the behest of the European Commission and is designed to slash IRI's debts. IRI owns some 64 percent of Stet's ordinary stock.
